educationalGoal:
Acquire the mathematical knowledge necessary to learn robotics.
Further improve your basic academic ability by participating in lectures and exercises related to the content of other classes offered during the same semester.
advice:
In “Mathematical Fundamentals of Robotics”, two subjects are designated from the required subjects offered in the same semester as active learning consisting of comprehensive exercises. This course, which can be taken as an elective, is intended to promote your learning skills and to deepen your understanding of the required courses.

In Mathematical Fundamentals of Robotics II, the exercises for Electronic Circuit and Introduction to Control Engineering/Control Engineering I are carried out every other week. Depending on the level of understanding of students in the course, the content of the lecture and the learning objectives are reviewed, together with the taking of quizzes and completion of exercises.

Summarizing and reviewing the lessons learned in the latter two courses is a preparation and review task for this course.
requiredKnowledge: Review and understand the content of Electronic Circuit and Introduction to Control Engineering/Control Engineering I.
